Use the assets in any game (commercial or not).
Edit or modify them however you like.
Use the assets for any other digital media (Videos, Animations, etc...).
2. What you can't do
Don't resell, redistribute, or share the assets on their own (even if modified or edited).
Don't include them in asset packs, templates or bundles.
Don't use the assets for any AI digital creation.
